description:
The manual CI script no longer resolves to a success outcome while a security audit is skipped or failing.

## Background

`scripts/test-ci-manual.sh` skips the Cargo security audit when `cargo-audit` is absent and converts npm-audit failures into warnings, yet still ends by printing "All CI checks complete." It is fail-open. A missing audit tool or a failing audit must not resolve to a success outcome.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `scripts/test-ci-manual.sh` does not print its success outcome when a required security audit is skipped or failing.
- [hard] REQ-02: A missing `cargo-audit` tool, a non-clean `cargo audit`, or a non-clean `npm audit` resolves to a non-success outcome rather than the "All CI checks complete" message.

## Notes

The script should fail closed: an unavailable or failing audit is a failure, not a warning.
title: Make the manual CI script fail closed on skipped audits
